title: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be
called the Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 15th day of February,
1990.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
2. Amendment of section 2 of Act III of 1990.--In the Bolan Medical
College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990, hereinafter referred to as the said
Act, in the preamble, after the word "affairs" the commas and words
", and other matters relating to," shall be inserted.

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
3. Amendment of section 2 of Act III of 1990.--In the said Act, in
section 2,--
(a) before clause (a) the
following new clause shall be inserted, and thereafter the existing clauses
(a), (b), (c), (d) and (e) shall be renumbered as (b), (c), (d), (e) and :-
"(a)
"affairs" includes, entering into, and modification or revocation of
contracts and agreements relating to the construction, supervision,
consultation and engineering services in respect of buildings and
superstructures including those being supervised by Pak PWD or any of their
officers of Agency, or constructed thereafter, and all other matters incidental
to, or connected with, the running administration and management of the
College;"
(b) for clause (d), so as amended
the following shall be substituted:--
"(d)
"College" means the Bolan Medical College Complex and includes any
hospital, building and superstructure attached to the College or forming part
of, or appertaining to, the Complex;"

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 3 of Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
4. Amendment of section 3 of Act III of 1990.--In the said Act,
after subsection (3) of section 3, the following new subsection shall be
inserted, namely:--
"(4) The
Board shall be a body corporate having perpetual succession and a common seal
with power to hold and possess movable and immovable property, and shall by the
name of the Board of Governors of Bolan Medical College sue and be sued."

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of section 4 of Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
5. Amendment of section 4 of Act III of 1990.---In the said Act,
after subsection (2) of section 4, the following new subsection shall be
added:--
"(3)
Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act and without prejudice to the
powers contained in subsection (1) above, the Board shall have and always be
deemed to have had power to enter into, modify or revoke any contract,
agreement relating to construction, execution, supervision, consultation and
engineering services in respect of buildings and superstructures and properties
of the College including those supervised or executed by Pak PWD or their
officers, or any other agency or person, whether such buildings or
superstructures or property existed at the commencement of this Act, or whether
such contract, agreement is entered into, modified or revoked before or after
the commencement of this Act and all other matters incidental to or connected
with the running administration, management or construction of the
College."

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 6A in Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
6. Insertion of new section 6A in Act III of 1990.--In the said
Act, after section 6, the following new section shall be inserted:--
"6-A, College property.---All
assets and properties of the Government to the college, including the land on
which the building of the College stands and the said building, whether
existing at the commencement of this Act, or constructed thereafter, shall,
asset or property, on the commencement of this Act, stand transferred to, and
vest in the Board."

sections.shortTitle: Bolan Medical College Board of Governors Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Insertion of new section 13-A in Act III of 1990

ACT VI OF 1992
ACT VI OF 1992
BOLAN MEDICAL COLLEGE (BOARD OF GOVERNORS) (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act to amend the Bolan
Medical College (Board of Governors) Act, 1990
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 20th September, 1992]
No. PAB.Legis.1II(28)/91, dated
20-9-1992.--The Bolan Medical College (Board of Governors) (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 27th
July, 1992, and assented to by the Governor of Balochistan is hereby published
as an Act of the Provincial Assembly.
7. Insertion of new section 13-A in Act III of 1990.--In the said
Act, after section 13, the following new section shall be inserted:--
"13-A.
Validation.--Any action taken, contract or agreement relating to, or in respect
of or in connection with the affairs of the Bolan Medical College, executed,
entered into, varied or revoked here to before by any officer of the Pakistan
Public Works Department or by, or on behalf of, the Board of Governors of the
said College, and all other acts incidental thereto, are, notwithstanding
anything contained in the said Act, or any other law or instrument having the
force of law for the time being in force or any decision of any Court, hereby
declared to have been, and shall be deemed always to have been, validly taken,
executed, entered into, varied or revoked or done, and shall not be called in
question in any Court on any ground whatsoever.
